metadata.eval_name: Conway's Game of Life with Emojis

messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements Conway's Game of Life with advanced features.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders Conway's Game of Life on the provided canvas
- Uses emojis to represent cells with different emojis for different generations
- Includes famous patterns: Glider, Blinker, Gosper Gun, Pulsar (selectable via dropdown)
- Speed control slider (1-10 generations per second)
- Click-to-toggle cells for custom patterns
- "Randomize" and "Clear" buttons
- Aging system where cells change emojis based on survival time
- Death animation with fade-out effect
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function startGameOfLife(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;canvas.width=500;canvas.height=500;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const cellSize=10;const cols=canvas.width/cellSize|0;const rows=canvas.height/cellSize|0;let grid=new Array(rows);let nextGrid=new Array(rows);let ageGrid=new Array(rows);let fadeGrid=new Array(rows);for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){grid[y]=new Uint8Array(cols);nextGrid[y]=new Uint8Array(cols);ageGrid[y]=new Uint16Array(cols);fadeGrid[y]=new Float32Array(cols);}const emojis=['🟦','🟩','🟨','🟥','🟪'];const deathEmoji='⚫';let speed=5;let lastUpdate=0;let generation=0;function randomize(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x]=Math.random()<0.3?1:0;ageGrid[y][x]=grid[y][x];fadeGrid[y][x]=0;}}function clearGrid(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x]=0;ageGrid[y][x]=0;fadeGrid[y][x]=0;}}function setPattern(pattern){clearGrid();function place(x0,y0,shape){for(let [dx,dy] of shape){let x=x0+dx,y=y0+dy;if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows){grid[y][x]=1;ageGrid[y][x]=1;}}}if(pattern==='glider'){place(1,1,[[0,0],[1,0],[2,0],[2,1],[1,2]]);}else if(pattern==='blinker'){place(5,5,[[0,0],[1,0],[2,0]]);}else if(pattern==='pulsar'){let pts=[[2,0],[3,0],[4,0],[8,0],[9,0],[10,0],[0,2],[5,2],[7,2],[12,2],[0,3],[5,3],[7,3],[12,3],[0,4],[5,4],[7,4],[12,4],[2,5],[3,5],[4,5],[8,5],[9,5],[10,5],[2,7],[3,7],[4,7],[8,7],[9,7],[10,7],[0,8],[5,8],[7,8],[12,8],[0,9],[5,9],[7,9],[12,9],[0,10],[5,10],[7,10],[12,10],[2,12],[3,12],[4,12],[8,12],[9,12],[10,12]];for(let [dx,dy] of pts)place(5+dx,5+dy,[[0,0]]);}else if(pattern==='gosper'){let cells=[[0,4],[0,5],[1,4],[1,5],[10,4],[10,5],[10,6],[11,3],[11,7],[12,2],[12,8],[13,2],[13,8],[14,5],[15,3],[15,4],[15,5],[15,6],[16,4],[16,5],[17,2],[17,3],[17,4],[17,6],[17,7],[17,8],[20,5],[22,3],[22,4],[22,5],[23,3],[23,4],[23,5],[24,2],[24,6],[26,1],[26,2],[26,6],[26,7],[36,3],[36,4],[37,3],[37,4]];for(let [dx,dy] of cells)place(1+dx,1+dy,[[0,0]]);} }function evolve(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){let neighbors=0;for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)if(!(dx===0&&dy===0)){let ny=y+dy,nx=x+dx;if(ny>=0&&ny<rows&&nx>=0&&nx<cols)neighbors+=grid[ny][nx];}let alive=grid[y][x];if(alive){if(neighbors<2||neighbors>3){nextGrid[y][x]=0;fadeGrid[y][x]=1;ageGrid[y][x]=0;}else{nextGrid[y][x]=1;ageGrid[y][x]=Math.min(ageGrid[y][x]+1,emojis.length-1);}}else{nextGrid[y][x]=0;}}let tmp=grid;grid=nextGrid;nextGrid=tmp;generation++;}function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.textBaseline='top';ctx.font=cellSize+'px Arial';for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){let v=grid[y][x];if(v){let age=ageGrid[y][x];let emoji=emojis[age%emojis.length];ctx.fillText(emoji,x*cellSize,y*cellSize);}else if(fadeGrid[y][x]>0){ctx.globalAlpha=fadeGrid[y][x];ctx.fillText(deathEmoji,x*cellSize,y*cellSize);ctx.globalAlpha=1;fadeGrid[y][x]-=0.04;if(fadeGrid[y][x]<=0)fadeGrid[y][x]=0;}}}function loop(ts){if(ts-lastUpdate>1000/speed){evolve();lastUpdate=ts;}draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}function toggleCell(e){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();let x=Math.floor((e.clientX-rect.left)/cellSize);let y=Math.floor((e.clientY-rect.top)/cellSize);if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows){grid[y][x]=grid[y][x]?0:1;ageGrid[y][x]=grid[y][x];fadeGrid[y][x]=0;}}canvas.addEventListener('click',toggleCell);const container=document.createElement('div');container.style.display='flex';container.style.alignItems='center';container.style.gap='10px';container.style.marginTop='10px';const patternSelect=document.createElement('select');['glider','blinker','pulsar','gosper'].forEach(p=>{let o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p;o.textContent=p.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+p.slice(1);patternSelect.appendChild(o);});patternSelect.addEventListener('change',()=>setPattern(patternSelect.value));const speedLabel=document.createElement('label');speedLabel.textContent='Speed:';const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='1';speedSlider.max='10';speedSlider.value='5';speedSlider.addEventListener('input',()=>{speed=+speedSlider.value;});const randomBtn=document.createElement('button');randomBtn.textContent='Randomize';randomBtn.onclick=randomize;const clearBtn=document.createElement('button');clearBtn.textContent='Clear';clearBtn.onclick=clearGrid;container.appendChild(patternSelect);container.appendChild(speedLabel);container.appendChild(speedSlider);container.appendChild(randomBtn);container.appendChild(clearBtn);canvas.parentNode.insertBefore(container,canvas.nextSibling);randomize();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
